A [[human]] '''elector''' represented the [[Ghorman (people)|Ghorman people]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. In [[3 BBY]], they attended a [[Palmo Town Hall|town hall]] meeting in [[Palmo]] where they listened to the grievances of the local population against the [[Galactic Empire]]. During the meeting they had a short brown beard and wore a black [[clothing|suit]]. At one point during the meeting they shouted at an individual named [[Lezine]] for interrupting a [[Unidentified old woman|woman]] who was talking to the group of electors.<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman" />

== Personality and traits ==
The elector had light skin, [[color|blue]] [[eye]]s, and brown hair.

==Behind the scenes==
The elector appeared in "[[Ever Been to Ghorman?]]", the fourth episode, of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' which was released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman" /> on [[April 29]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> The character was portrayed by [[David Bertrand]].<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman" />
